name: context-handoff
description: In a /ship cycle, writes a handoff (ledger and Maestri note) when the Maestro context reaches its ceiling, then optionally runs /clear.

ceilingPercent.title: Handoff ceiling (%)
ceilingPercent.description: Context percent at which the Maestro writes its handoff. The ship skill uses 35.

autoClear.title: Run /clear after the handoff
autoClear.description: Off: the handoff is automatic and a toast asks you to run /clear. On: the plugin runs /clear itself, only after it saw the ledger change.
